entities.summary: Blaine Thomas Boyer is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Atlanta Braves, St. Louis Cardinals, Arizona Diamondbacks, New York Mets, Minnesota Twins, San Diego Padres, Milwaukee Brewers, Boston Red Sox, and Kansas City Royals. He also played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hanshin Tigers.
